name: Hexahedral Mesh Traversal (Bilinear Patch-Extension)
definition: A hybrid traversal method combining Plücker tests for face selection and bilinear patch tests for intersection to avoid singularities and discontinuities.
summary: Hexahedral Mesh Traversal (Bilinear Patch-Extension) is a hybrid algorithm that uses bilinear patch intersections to compute parametric coordinates, avoiding triangle decomposition and eliminating discontinuities at face boundaries.
